title: fix(ui): keep Ask OpenClaw answer focus during background updates
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: keyboard focus disappears from an Ask OpenClaw answer when a routine Gateway event refreshes the page.

## User Impact

Users can keep navigating answer choices and press Enter to submit the focused answer while background updates arrive.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Solid conversion recreated answer buttons when their caller supplied fresh option objects. Keying each button by its stable answer value preserves focus while keeping its label, description, selection, and click behavior current.

## Evidence

The mounted Custodian page regression failed on the original component when a health event moved focus from Pause to the document body. The fix retains focus and sends the correct answer. Isolated Chromium and WebKit flows against the real UI with a synthetic Gateway also preserve focus and submit Pause with Enter.

`pnpm test ui/src/pages/custodian/custodian-page.nudges.test.ts ui/src/components/option-card.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 23 tests passed; 13.517 seconds wall, with the new regression taking 450 ms under host load. The earlier main Custodian page and option-card run passed all 34 tests.

Production UI and owning UI page-test types, scoped formatting, lint, styles, line-count/assertion/timer/mock-export/Lit ratchets, and independent review through P2 pass. Before/after screenshots show the answer focus ring after the same background event.

![Before: background update loses answer focus](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/86f8b825-c315-493e-9e4f-9418c5686f9e)

![After: answer focus survives the background update](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/be315f56-c9f7-4603-96e3-a987f8b4391e)

Hosted verification: exact-head CI run 38173163354 passed all 28 executed checks, including the aggregate gate. ClawSweeper reported zero findings and no before-merge requirements. In checks-ui (1/3), the modified test file took 2.794 seconds and the new regression took 166 ms.
